name: River Valley
summary: High-rise living between Orchard and the Singapore River — city access, serviced-apartment density, and a common first-lease shortlist.
body: River Valley and the adjacent Mohamed Sultan / Robertson Quay stretch give you towers, river walks, and Orchard retail within a short hop. Singles and dual-income couples often land here for lifestyle density: gyms, restaurants, and late MRT options via Great World, Fort Canning, or Somerset. Family floorplans exist in newer developments, but outdoor play space is tower-courtyard rather than landed garden — many parents eventually migrate toward Bukit Timah or East Coast once school runs dominate. Serviced apartments are common, which makes the area useful for lawful short landing stays before a 12–24 month lease. Noise and construction cycles are part of the deal; walk the block at 10pm before you LOI.
housingMix: Mostly high-rise condominiums; serviced apartments common for arrivals.
commuteNotes: Great World / Fort Canning / Somerset nearby; walkable to parts of Orchard and the river.
